Samira Lee: Thanks for the all-hands! Quick follow-ups on performance review timeline and promo exceptions — can folks confirm when manager calibration completes and when individual notices go out? Also any change to appeal window?
Evan Brooks (People Ops): Short answers: calibration completes by 2025-05-10, managers submit final ratings by 2025-05-08, notices go out 2025-05-15, appeal window is 7 calendar days after notice. Will post a timeline + FAQ doc later today.
Devon Patel: Thanks. For promo exceptions — is there a formal process if someone's case was missed during calibration? Eg. new hire who ramped quickly after manager submissions.
Evan Brooks (People Ops): Yes — we have a late-exception workflow. Manager files a one-page form and needs an exec sponsor signoff. Exceptions accepted through the end of the cycle but comp adjustments may be limited depending on budget/timing. I'll drop the form link here.
hr-bot: Form: https://redwood.internal/hr/promo-exception :pushpin:
Marta Ruiz: Are salary adjustments for retroactive promotions handled in the next payroll or as a separate retro payment?
Evan Brooks (People Ops): Retro promotions are applied in the following payroll. If something gets missed, we process a separate retro payment within 30 days of the correction. Finance asked managers to flag changes ASAP to avoid delays.
Priya Sharma: Quick question on parental leave — leadership said there was a policy update coming. Any ETA? Specifically curious about top-up pay for folks with 6+ months tenure.
Evan Brooks (People Ops): Draft of the parental leave policy is with leadership now; final expect by 2025-06-01. Early summary: 6+ months tenure will be eligible for 8 weeks full top-up for primary caregivers. Full details and the top-up calculator will be published with the policy.
Samira Lee: Appreciate that. Can we get People Ops office hours next week for managers who want 1:1 clarification? Some teams prefer small Q&A rather than the doc.
Evan Brooks (People Ops): Yep — booking two 30-min slots: Wed 10:00–11:00 and Thu 15:00–16:00. I'll post a sign-up sheet after this thread.
Devon Patel: One more — will leveling criteria change for L4->L5 this cycle? Eng has a lot of questions about cross-functional expectations.
Evan Brooks (People Ops): No major bar changes this cycle. We did refine and add example behaviors for cross-functional roles (Eng/PM/Design). I'll attach the updated rubric examples in the doc.
Samira Lee: :thumbsup: Thanks Evan. Ping here when the doc + links are live and I'll forward to my managers for FYI.
